commit-heredoc:
git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add infra

nohup python3 worker.py &
gcloud compute instances create cm-vm --zone us-central1-a
docker compose up -d
EOF
)"
pr-heredoc:
gh pr create --title x --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Test plan
- docker run -d --name prvm redis
- terraform apply -auto-approve
EOF
)"
python-c-multiline:
python3 -c "
import os
os.system('ls')
print('nohup x &')
"
ssh-remote: ssh vm1 'docker run -d --name remote redis && nohup python3 srv.py &'
gcloud-ssh-cmd: gcloud compute ssh vm1 --zone us-central1-a --command 'nohup python3 train.py > t.log 2>&1 &'
